results.summary: Retired version-0.1.0 first-publish.yml workflow by making workflow_dispatch fail closed and removing the publish job. Configured shared non-cancelling release lock (release-publish-lock, cancel-in-progress: false) across release execution so competing tags and same-tag reruns serialize without cancelling in-flight publishes. Verified interrupted publish, confirmation, and release note creation steps are idempotent. Ensured scripts/owner-publish.sh enforces eligibility parity (semver, clean tree, main branch, crates.io probe soft-skip, exact-SHA CI, and ci-publish-ready). Verified release-plz remains PR-only. Added 15 unit tests covering serialization, locking, idempotence, and publisher retirement.

limits: Offline test validation; no crates.io publication, git tag creation, or network operations performed.
